1. Abre o rFactor e prepara o combustíve:
1. Open rFactor and prepare the fuel, tires and conditions you will use in the race.
2. In Overlay → Stint, choose Laps or Minutes and the duration.
3. Accept the suggestion or enter the target pace and ± consistency window — for example, 1:22.700 ±0.50 s marks 1:22.200 to 1:23.200. Laps faster than 1:22.200 also count in the window.
4. Press Start stint before crossing the finish line. The exit lap is left out.
5. In minute training, the lap ends when the time reaches zero. At the end, consult the graph and the average of all completed laps, including invalid ones.
70 pontos de ritmo + 30 de limpeza. Uma:
70 rhythm points + 30 cleansing. An average to target + tolerance receives 70 points; faster keeps the maximum score. Above this limit, the pace loses points linearly and reaches zero when the additional difference reaches 5% of the target. The average includes invalid laps.
Cleaning loses 10 points for each exit for 10 laps, until losing 30 points. Example: 15 laps at the pace and 1 exit gives 93/100; 3 exits give 80/100. The note is rounded to the nearest integer.
The grade is provisional during training and partial if you finish before the goal. Telemetry failures make the assessment estimable. No turns, no note. The outputs are local estimates, not official penalties or GTC ratings.
A GTC tem prioridade nos gráficos. Os re: GTC has priority in graphics. Local records only supplement missing laps from a confirmed session; without a safe match the chart awaits data from GTC. The cross also identifies possibly invalid or incomplete turns: consult the point to distinguish. The compound and tire values ​​available appear discreetly on the graph; Null data is not presented as confirmed wear. Refreshing GTC queries the available online history, which may be incomplete. The local backup collection is on this PC.
